package.name: 5e (2024 Edition)
package.description: Play Game Mode by the 2024 revised 5e rules: updated character progression, 13 classes including Artificer, Level-1 half-caster spell progression, 2024 species and backgrounds with Origin Feats, 2024 Weapon Masteries, updated Exhaustion, bonus-action potions, and extensive monster bestiaries built from your owned 5etools library. After installing, choose it under Rules in the Game Mode setup wizard when you create a new game.
